prompt: A huge derelict foundry tower crane on a heavy riveted steel pedestal: a tall square lattice-girder tower, a slewing platform on top with an enclosed boxy operator's cab with windows, a long horizontal lattice jib reaching forward and a short counter-jib reaching back that carries a massive rectangular cast-iron counterweight block. From the end of the jib a cable hangs straight down to a boxy relay housing with antennae and a small dish instead of a hook. A ladder runs up the tower. Soot-blackened heavy industrial forge-world machinery. Isolated 3D model render on a plain uniform medium-grey studio background, the whole object fully in frame with generous margin, three-quarter view from slightly above, soft even studio lighting, no cast shadow, no text, no lettering, no logos, no people. Crisp hard-surface modelling with bold, clearly separated parts and a strong readable silhouette: chunky forms and clean edges, no clutter, no hanging moss, no dangling wires.
